channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Juancho Hernangomez | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Juancho Hernangomez from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Juancho Hernangomez
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Nick Nurse on Juancho Hernangomez:

“He knows how to play the game. I've always thought that about him over the years... He's got a good IQ. He understands spacing and communication... We should be able to use him.”

Nick Nurse on Juancho Hernangomez, Sep 26, 2022. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Gersson Rosas on Juancho Hernangomez
item.description:
Rosas on his ruling that Juancho Hernangomez won’t play in Olympics:

“Juancho needs time to recover from and rehabilitate his injury, and that timeline restricts Juancho’s availability to participate in the Tokyo Olympics. The determined recovery plan is the best path forward.”

Gersson Rosas on Juancho Hernangomez, Jul 24, 2021. Source: Twitter @DaneMooreNBA.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Juancho Hernangomez
item.description:
Anthony Edwards on Juancho Hernangomez:

“Juancho can shoot the piss off the ball, shoot the hell out the ball. I tell Juancho, 'if you catch the ball open and don't shoot it, you losing money. That easy. That simple. That's what you get paid to do my n****.'”

Anthony Edwards on Juancho Hernangomez, Mar 19, 2021. Source: Twitter @DaneMooreNBA.

item.title: Sachin Gupta on Malik Beasley, Juancho Hernangomez
item.description:
Sachin Gupta on the free agencies of Malik Beasley and Juancho Hernangomez:

“We do have plenty of room below the tax. We’ve got our own free agents with Malik and Juancho, so with the Bird rights we’ll be able to re-sign those guys.”

Sachin Gupta on Malik Beasley, Juancho Hernangomez, Oct 28, 2020. Source: Twitter @DaneMooreNBA.
